name: John Duarte
bio: a Representative from California; born in Modesto, Stanislaus County, Calif., September 9, 1966; B.S., San Diego State University, San Diego, Calif., 1989; M.B.A., University of the Pacific, Stockton, Calif., 1997; farmer; business owner; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress (January 3, 2023-January 3, 2025); unsuccessful candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024.
